description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yuna], [Invoke Bahamut Ability Tracker], [Invoke Bahamut Level] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yuna
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Invoke Bahamut (0~2), removed after using Invoke Bahamut two times

description.name: Invoke Bahamut Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Invoke Bahamut level by 1 after using 7 White Magic or Summoning abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yuna]

description.name: Invoke Bahamut Level
description.text: Keeps track of Invoke Bahamut level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yuna]
